newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Four stocks closed lower and two higher in 6.1-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Thursday.
The remaining 15 stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 3.5 percent in an 11.1-million- zloty turnover.
The continuous trading system, which currently lists 21 companies, is separate from the bourse's main single-price auction system in which the same firms and 62 others are traded.
At the single-price auction session most stocks rose and the main market's index gained 0.8 percent.
